_about: 亚比 whose numbers the later table (the source of gen_pmdata.py) changed after 2013–14, as they were then: 种族值 (s: 体力, 攻击, 防御, 特攻, 特防, 速度), 属性 (t) and skills learnt (learn: [level, skill id]; the skills are rows of the same table). Sources: the 4399 pages of 2013–14 (the 伊乐 and 圣·天伊 skill tables by 阿丸, the 种族值 tables), as the user gave them. sk: the first 12 skill names, as the 图鉴's search table lists them (gen_pets.py).
